name: honda_vision_sport
title: Honda Vision 110, the Sport version (Việt Nam)

sources.name: Honda Việt Nam, Vision, the Sport version (Phiên bản Thể thao): the table of the specifications

numbers.name: length
numbers.standard: The overall length (dài): from the front to the back of the scooter.

numbers.name: width
numbers.standard: The overall width (rộng): of the bars with their grips and their mirrors.

numbers.name: height
numbers.standard: The overall height (cao): the top of the mirrors over the ground.

numbers.name: wheelbase
numbers.standard: The wheelbase (khoảng cách trục bánh xe): from the front axle to the rear axle.

numbers.name: seat height
numbers.standard: The seat height (độ cao yên): the lowest point of the top of the seat at the place of the rider.

numbers.name: ground clearance
numbers.standard: The ground clearance (khoảng sáng gầm xe): the lowest point between the axles, with no wheel.

numbers.name: curb mass
numbers.standard: The curb mass (khối lượng bản thân), with a full tank. The parts that the drawing does not show (the frame under the body, the inner panels, the wires) have masses by estimate, so the tolerance is 10%.
